accepted_edits.reason: the s47 edit answers the two findings of the content review: lookups of ids with no run file, and no wait on s45

findings.reason: as written the node ships a green node whose gate cannot fail, on the one behaviour the section exists to change.
findings.text: both tests and the negative control measure through `has_row`, but `open_run_index.has_row` (reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:654) returns True on `ledger.run_path(project, run_id, root).is_file()` before `_ensure` is ever called, so for any run id of the 50-run ledger the assertion "the next has_row calls ledger.load zero times" is vacuous and the stated control "at the base revision the plan write makes the next has_row call ledger.load" is false — the plan never says the looked-up id is one whose run file is absent and which exists only as a ledger row, which is the only shape that reaches `_ensure`

findings.reason: the declaration blocks an independent node behind one whose head currently adds 240 failures against its base, delaying it for no dependency the plan's own content describes.
findings.text: `_document` declares `"s47": ["the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once#s45"]`, but s47's deliverable and write paths (`reckon/ledger.py`, `reckon/_store.py`, `reckon/crew/open_run_index.py`) share nothing with s45's review-store index work, so the node is held until an unrelated, still-unlanded section lands

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/ledger.py:1204`, `reckon/_store.py:1982`, `reckon/crew/open_run_index.py`, `open_run_index.has_row`, `recovery_review_dispatch._open_review_refusal` and the named test path all resolve as the section says.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — s47's done-when rests on `has_row` for a run id whose run file exists, and `has_row` answers that id from the filesystem before it ever reaches `_ensure`, so neither test nor the stated negative control can exercise the index generation.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the matched arms' logs are placed under the run directory, opening with revision and literal command and ending in `EXIT=`, on a durable path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test file and the section carry no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or changelog prose, and the mechanism is stated rather than a bug reference.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause matches the code: `ledger_generation` reads the plan-write generation and `_store.write_plan` advances that same counter, so a plan write invalidates the ledger index with no run row changed, which is the rebuild the profile reports.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the section names one deliverable, the ledger's own write generation, and one pair of measures that both bear on it.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — `_document`'s `plan-section-depends-on` gives `s47` a wait on `s45`, but s47's body touches none of the review-store paths s45 rewrites.
